description: This file defines the IconDefinition class in Drupal, handling icon configuration, creation, and rendering logic.

classes.name: IconDefinition
classes.description: Represents an icon definition in Drupal, providing methods for creation, data retrieval, and rendering.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new IconDefinition instance after validating input data.

methods.name: createIconId
methods.description: Generates a full icon ID from pack ID and icon ID.

methods.name: getIconDataFromId
methods.description: Extracts pack ID and icon ID from a full icon ID string.

methods.name: getRenderable
methods.description: Returns a render array for the icon based on its full ID and settings.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for the icon.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the full ID of the icon.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source URL or path of the icon.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group of the icon.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the template used for the icon.

methods.name: getPackLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the icon pack, if available.

methods.name: getLibrary
methods.description: Returns the library associated with the icon.

methods.name: getAllData
methods.description: Returns all data associated with the icon.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts a string into a human-readable format for admin display.
